remarks: An integral part of this home is the Zen gardens that are designed to encircle the perimeter of the unit, providing a continuous sense of tranquility and natural beauty creating an inviting and calming entry.  Whether you choose to take a dip in the pool or enjoy the beach, relaxation and recreation are just steps away. This renovated 2 Bedroom 1.5 bath Tri-level townhouse w/over 2100 sqft offers a sophisticated and elegant living space with beautiful hardwood floors throughout. Gourmet kitchen featuring granite countertops and stainless-steel appliances, open dining room/living room area with sliders to a private deck. The second level boasting two large bedrooms with multiple closets and a full bath ensures comfort and luxury. Fully finished lower level with a large family room and private laundry room.  Many newer improvements include Heat pump, air handler, water heater, dishwasher & washer/dryer. Updated windows, slider and front door. Situated in desirable Westcott Cove neighborhood, located in coveted Bishop Meadows association tucked away offering beautifully manicured grounds with clubhouse and in ground pool. Walk to beach, park, tennis courts & Chelsea Piers. Easy Commute minutes to train, downtown restaurants & shopping, 1 Reserved parking space(Next to unit) & plenty of visitor parking. End unit!!
